name: Typecast API
positioning: Typecast (Neosapience) is a voice platform whose separately priced API exposes 600+ character voices, emotion control (Smart Emotion), streaming, timestamps and instant voice cloning through its SSFM models.

pricing.model: Credit-based API plans separate from the Studio web plans: monthly credits (1 credit per character) with fixed-size pay-as-you-go top-ups once the allowance is used.
pricing.headline: Lite plan is $15 per month for 200k credits ($0.075 per 1k credits, i.e. $75 per 1M characters); pay-as-you-go beyond the allowance is $0.09 per 1k credits ($90 per 1M). Plus is $280 per month for 4M credits ($70 per 1M; $80 per 1M beyond).

tiers.name: Free
tiers.notes: Concurrency 2; output cannot be used commercially and must include attribution.

tiers.name: Lite
tiers.unit: USD per 1M characters (200k credits for $15/month; $0.075 per 1k credits)
tiers.notes: Concurrency 5; 50 custom voice slots; extra usage billed at $0.09 per 1k credits ($90 per 1M) in $9 / 100k-credit increments. Included-credit rate at 1 credit per character.

tiers.name: Plus
tiers.unit: USD per 1M characters (4M credits for $280/month; $0.07 per 1k credits)
tiers.notes: Concurrency 15; 800 custom voice slots; extra usage billed at $0.08 per 1k credits ($80 per 1M) in $100 / 1.25M-credit increments.

tiers.name: Enterprise
tiers.notes: Contact sales; dedicated account manager; no stated limit on custom voice slots.

pricing.freeTier: Free API plan: 15k credits per month (1 credit per character, so about 15,000 characters), concurrency 2; not for commercial use and requires attribution.

voices.languages: ssfm-v30 supports 35+ languages (37 listed in the models docs); ssfm-v21 supports 27
voices.customVoiceOrCloning: Instant Voice Cloning via POST /v1/voices/clone from WAV or MP3 samples (voice IDs start with uc_); custom voice slots per plan are 50 on Lite and 800 on Plus, with Professional Cloning slots of up to 2 and 5; the free plan lists no custom voice slots on the pricing page.

formats: wav (PCM 16-bit mono, 44.1 kHz; streaming WAV is 32 kHz)

compatibility.note: Uses its own REST API at https://api.typecast.ai with an X-API-KEY header, voice_id, model (ssfm-v30 or ssfm-v21) and a 1 to 2,000 character text field; no OpenAI-compatible route is documented. The docs state the API does not support SSML.

licensing.commercialUse: API Terms of Use license the APIs for commercial purposes; output from the free plan may not be used commercially.
licensing.attributionOrConditions: Free plan output published externally must clearly identify that it was created using Typecast and keep any attribution notice.

limits.perRequestCharacters: Text field is 1 to 2,000 characters per request.
limits.concurrency: Concurrency limit: Free 2, Lite 5, Plus 15, Enterprise custom.

sdks: MCP server and integrations for Zapier, Make, n8n, Pipecat and LlamaIndex

compliance.note: No compliance certification was found. The API Terms of Use ask customers to comply with GDPR and other data-protection laws when submitting personal data, which is a customer obligation rather than a vendor compliance claim.

strengths.claim: Offers 600+ character voices with Smart Emotion and seven emotion presets on ssfm-v30, covering 35+ languages.
Official SDKs in 13 programming languages plus a CLI, MCP server and no-code integrations.
Returns word- and character-level timestamps for captions, and supports HTTP streaming TTS for low-latency playback.
Public, per-credit API pricing with a free plan and plan-level concurrency and custom-voice limits listed.

limitations.claim: The API does not support SSML and does not expose a pronunciation dictionary.
Each request is limited to 2,000 characters.
Free-plan audio cannot be used commercially and must include attribution.

stepsToMove: Create an API key in the Typecast API console and send it in the X-API-KEY header (legacy Starter keys are not compatible with SSFM keys).

POST https://api.typecast.ai/v1/text-to-speech with JSON voice_id (tc_ for built-in, uc_ for cloned), text (1 to 2,000 characters), model (ssfm-v30 recommended), optional language (ISO 639-3), prompt (emotion) and output (audio_format wav or mp3, pitch, tempo, volume).
For low-latency playback use POST /v1/text-to-speech/stream; for captions use POST /v1/text-to-speech/with-timestamps.
Browse voices with GET /v3/voices and create custom ones with POST /v1/voices/clone.
Replace SSML with Typecast prompt, pause, tempo and pitch settings, and check credits and limits with GET /v1/users/me/subscription.

bestFor: Content and character-voice products that value emotional range and a large curated voice library with SDKs in many languages, and where per-character pricing of about $70 to $90 per million is acceptable.

unknowns: The '1 credit per character' conversion appears on the pricing page and was not found elsewhere (single-source); the docs say not to assume other conversions.
Whether a WebSocket streaming endpoint exists is not documented in the pages read.
No vendor-stated latency figure was found.
HIPAA, SOC 2 and GDPR compliance statements were not found.
The pricing page and its alternate URL returned identical content, so the plan prices are single-source.
Why Typecast was chosen: it has public API pricing and docs; the other candidates (Voicemod, Uberduck) were not researched.
